# Holy Ghost Academy Secondary School, Awka — Full Knowledge Document

## General Overview
Holy Ghost Academy Secondary School, Awka (HGASS) is a faith-grounded, academic center of excellence in Anambra State, Nigeria. Established in 2013 under the visionary pastoral leadership of Late Rev. Fr. Dr. Emmanuel Obuna, the academy fosters disciplined scholarship, Christian morals, and technological proficiency.

## Academic System & Curriculum
The school operates the Nigerian National 6-3-3-4 educational framework:
- Junior Secondary School (JSS 1, JSS 2, JSS 3) culminating in Basic Education Certificate Examination (BECE).
- Senior Secondary School (SS 1, SS 2, SS 3) offering Science, Arts, Commercial, and Technical streams preparing students for West African Senior School Certificate Examination (WASSCE) and National Examinations Council (NECO) Senior School Certificate Examination.

## Continuous Assessment & Grading Scheme
Academic evaluation per term:
- 1st Continuous Assessment (Test 1): 10 marks
- 2nd Continuous Assessment (Test 2 / Project): 10 marks
- Mid-Term Assessment / Practical: 10 marks
- Terminal Examination: 70 marks
- Total Terminal Score: 100 marks

Grading Standard:
- 75 - 100%: A1 (Distinction)
- 70 - 74%: B2 (Very Good)
- 65 - 69%: B3 (Good)
- 60 - 64%: C4 (Credit)
- 55 - 59%: C5 (Credit)
- 50 - 54%: C6 (Credit)
- 45 - 49%: D7 (Pass)
- 40 - 44%: E8 (Pass)
- 0 - 39%: F9 (Fail)

Annual Cumulative Results evaluate Term 1 (30%), Term 2 (30%), and Term 3 (40%) to determine promotional standing and cumulative GPA (out of 5.00).

## Student Performance Analytics
The results portal integrates dynamic longitudinal tracking using Recharts line visualization to allow students, parents, and academic counselors to track performance trajectories across all three academic terms.
